metadata.title: Design Systems Research Platform — Data Pipeline Reconciliation Report

pipeline_layers_audited.notes: All foreign keys intact, 0 orphaned records.
Missing invitation routes, component storybook endpoint, and system evidence endpoint.
Typescript types require synchronization with enhanced backend schemas.
Missing Storybook explorer, Verification evidence tabs, and Invite flow.
Need Next.js middleware to strictly enforce invitation-only private gating.

defects.root_cause: SystemOut & SystemDetail Pydantic schemas omit official_docs_url, related_urls, and verification_coverage columns.
defects.impact: Frontend never receives official documentation URLs or coverage metrics extracted during Phase 2 verification.
defects.resolution: Add official_docs_url, related_urls, and verification_coverage to SystemOut and SystemDetail schemas in backend/app/schemas/__init__.py.

defects.root_cause: dashboard.summary() and DashboardSummary schema omit storybook stories, component variants, showcase projects, and attribute evidence counts.
defects.impact: Dashboard metrics only reflect legacy counts; user cannot see 17,600 stories or 12,150 variants on the home dashboard.
defects.resolution: Expand dashboard.summary() and DashboardSummary schema with storybook_projects, storybook_stories, storybook_variants, and attribute_evidence.

defects.root_cause: Missing component-specific storybook endpoint (/components/{id}/storybook) or detail expansion.
defects.impact: 728 linked storybook stories and component variants cannot be browsed directly on the component detail page.
defects.resolution: Add GET /components/{id}/storybook endpoint returning linked stories and CSF variants.

defects.impact: Field-level verified attribute evidence (312 records) cannot be accessed directly within the system detail view.
defects.resolution: Add GET /design-systems/{id}/evidence endpoint returning verified attribute evidence.

defects.root_cause: Invitation endpoints not mounted in API router despite service layer implementation in backend/app/services/invitations.py.
defects.impact: Admin cannot create, list, resend, or revoke invitations via API; invited recipients cannot validate tokens, send codes, or accept invitations.
defects.resolution: Implement and mount /admin/invitations and /invitations routes in backend/app/api/v1/routes/administration.py and auth.py.

defects.root_cause: Storybook showcase projects, stories, and variants are not included in Platform Shell navigation.
defects.impact: 103 projects, 17,600 stories, and 12,150 variants are undiscoverable via the platform UI.
defects.resolution: Add Storybook navigation entry in Shell.tsx and create /platform/storybook explorer page with projects, stories, and variants tabs.

defects.root_cause: System detail page lacks Official Docs / Verification tab and Storybook project links.
defects.impact: Verified attributes and official documentation evidence are hidden from users inspecting a design system.
defects.resolution: Add Official Evidence tab and Storybook link to src/app/platform/systems/[id]/page.tsx.

defects.root_cause: Component detail page lacks Storybook stories and variants tab.
defects.impact: Component props from CSF stories, args, and variant matrices are invisible in the component detail view.

defects.root_cause: Admin users page uses direct password creation instead of invite-only lifecycle.
defects.impact: No invitation management interface for generating single-use, expiring invites, tracking delivery status, or revoking tokens.
defects.resolution: Add Invitations tab to src/app/platform/admin/page.tsx with invite creation, status tracking, resend, and revoke controls.

defects.impact: Recipients who click an invitation delivery link encounter a 404 or unauthenticated redirect.
defects.resolution: Build src/app/platform/invite/page.tsx with URL fragment token extraction (#token=...), 6-digit code verification, and password registration.

defects.root_cause: Missing Next.js middleware route guard; public (atlas) static pages accessible without authentication.
defects.impact: Platform is not strictly private; unauthenticated visitors can view editorial design system catalogs.
defects.resolution: Implement src/middleware.ts enforcing session validation, redirecting unauthenticated requests to /platform/login, and gating all research routes.
